Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup.
Edit target: the provided original 3D model assembly render. Make a beautiful finished miniature catalogue product image for BONSAI3D. Subject: straw-hatted travelling ronin, round hanging lantern in the lowered hand, sculpted rocky circular base.
Preserve the EXACT existing sculptural design, pose, face, anatomy, hands and finger placement, lantern dimensions and frame, all clothing folds, proportions, accessories, and entire scenic base. This is a photo-style finish visualization of THIS small resin model, NOT a redesign. Do not add new sculpted ornament, new objects, or new anatomy; do not change the light chamber.
Replace the flat grey CAD material with a sophisticated hand-painted miniature finish consistent with a bonsai miniatures collection: matte black charcoal primer, carefully controlled warm grey and ivory drybrush on raised details, subtle natural muted grey-green touches only on existing sculpted foliage. Avoid vivid colours. Face and hands remain painted miniature material, not real flesh. A restrained warm amber glow comes only from INSIDE the existing lantern's translucent panels, softly catching nearby fingers; preserve the lantern's dark structural bars.
Photograph the complete small tabletop miniature on a warm neutral pale stone tabletop with a softly blurred warm taupe studio wall. Soft diffused daylight, realistic contact shadow, crisp finely painted sculptural detail, premium quiet natural product photography, modest depth of field, visually consistent with black-primer/white-drybrush bonsai miniature catalogue. Square 1254x1254 composition, entire original model including top, whole base and all parts comfortably visible with 8-12% margin. No bonsai/tree, no added props, no text, no branding, no border, no montage, no collage, no watermark. Do not crop the top or base. Clearly a miniature, not a life-size human.
